findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set to true, so this customer-managed key never rotates. A long-lived key keeps the same key material in service indefinitely, widening the window in which a compromised or exfiltrated key exposes all data encrypted under it, contrary to CIS Foundations 3.8 and the secure key-management guidance.
